user.title: Connect your panel
user.description: Enter the shared token from the Pi. The connection check does not wake the screen. Use an unused dashboard URL.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure panel
reconfigure.description: Re-enter the shared token. Edit camera and card mappings in the dashboard UI; changing the URL requires removing and re-adding the integration.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the panel. Check its address and update the Pi endpoint if /health is unavailable.
error.invalid_config: Check the panel name, hostname, token, and dashboard URL.
error.dashboard_exists: That dashboard URL already exists. Choose another URL.
error.dashboard_path_changed: Keep the existing dashboard URL when reconfiguring.

abort.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different panel.
